description.narrative: The Tuvalu Long-term Adaptation Plan (L-TAP) aims to support protection of the country from the impact of rising sea level and other impacts of climate change, which threaten the country. L-TAP was prepared by the Government of Tuvalu with assistance from the UNDP. The objective of this specific 24 month project is to support climate adaptation in Tuvalu by funding the initial due diligence studies for L-TAP.

description.narrative: Australia along with ADB, provided technical assistance to Fiji’s Ministry of Finance to undertake its most ambitious IT project to replace the 2-decade old Financial Management Information System (FMIS) and the 40-year-old payroll system. The new system is a web-based, integrated platform that replaces the previous standalone FMIS and payroll systems and will allow in the future integration of the debt management and budget preparation modules. The new system will bring about greater efficiency in accounting processes, improve financial reporting, strengthen internal controls, audit trails, and enhance cyber security. The payroll module streamlines salary processing, eliminates manual data entry, and allows payroll monitoring on a real time basis. The new FMIS also enables easier generation of customized reports, including disaggregated data for specific categories like climate change and gender-based activities. The new system is part of a broader effort to modernize Fiji's financial management processes and align them with international best practice. The implementation of the new FMIS was part of the suite of mutually agreed reforms in DFAT’s budget support program.
